explanation: Read-only revalidation after pinning exact Oximut coverage names derived from ordinary Vitest ancestorTitles/title. Original measurements/summary unchanged; no mutant/source edits or test drops. Explicit family labels added from original commands.

artifact_phase_metrics.source: sum of Vitest assertion duration; excludes discovery/transform/startup

diagnostics: execution=persistent; isolation=fresh-test-forks; controller reuse only; baseline=original-and-disabled-switches

resources.enforcement: best-effort sampled admission and process-tree cancellation; existing cgroup limits are OS-enforced; no new hard cap installed
resources.measurement: Linux /proc smaps_rollup Rss sum, approximate stat RSS fallback on older/restricted kernels: main CLI and all worker/adapter/controller/test descendants; shared pages counted per process
